दक्षिणरेलवे/SOUTHERN RAILWAY 

चेनै्नमंडल/CHENNAI DIVISION 

No.PUB/MAS/2024/07/06                                                                                             Date: 12.07.2024 

 

पे्रसिवज्ञक्षि/PRESS  RELEASE 

 

CHANGES IN PATTERN OF TRAIN SERVICES 

 

According t o  Priority to passenger safety and Safety of train operations, as a part of 
ongoing Engineering works, Line Block/Power Block is permitted in Chennai Egmore - 
Villupuram section between Chennai Beach and Chennai Egmore on 14th July 2024 
from 07:45 hrs to 19:45 hrs (12 Hours) for construction of new culvert at Chennai 
Egmore Yard . Consequently the following are the changes in Pattern of Express Train 
services and EMU trains services. 

A. CHANGES IN PATTERN OF EXPRESS TRAIN SERVICES:  

1. Train No. 12651, Madurai – Hazrat Nizamuddin TamilNadu Sampark Kranti Express is diverted

B. CHANGES IN PATTERN OF EMU TRAIN SERVICES ON 14TH JULY 2024: 

EMU trains scheduled between 07.45 hrs and 19.45 hrs will be fully cancelled in 
Chennai Beach – Chengalpattu section.
